company_name: NEW AGE INSUTRUMENTS AND MATERIALS PRIVATE LIMITED
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides scientific instrumentation solutions relevant to semiconductor research and industrial applications.
summary: New Age Instruments and Materials Private Limited specializes in scientific instrumentation solutions for semiconductor research and industrial applications. Established in 1999, the company serves both government-funded research laboratories and industrial clients across India, with a focus on customer-specific needs and after-sales support.

regional_presence.India: The company has its main office in Gurugram and a branch in Navi Mumbai, ensuring comprehensive support across the country.
